_source: bridge2ai-redcap Pediatrics/Acoustic Tasks/Current/Identifying Pictures. The target word is rendered as printed text on each flashcard image (pediatric_identifying_pictures_{01..37}.jpg); it is neither in the task name nor in the instructions, so it is transcribed here once (the 37 cards are fixed and shared across all participants). 1-based: words[i-1] is the target for identifying-pictures-<i>. speech_type is 'read' -- the child says the printed word (several cards, e.g. MY/GO/ONE, are sight words that cannot be named from the picture alone), so this is a WER-scorable reference.
